Maria Chen: Heads-up — saw a tail-latency regression on L4 when we enabled entropy-aware packing + aggressive max-token capping. 95th/99th jumped ~30-50% on a cold KV cache workload. Anyone seen this pattern before?

Ajay Gupta: Can you paste the perf run id / flamegraph? Is it just latency or also throughput drop?

Maria Chen: Throughput steady, but p99 latency spikes and jitter. Profiling attached below. Run id perf/9872. Flamegraph link: https://perf.redwood/perf/9872

perf-bot: Profiling run queued: perf/9872 (collector: continuous-batching, env: staging, config: entropy-packing=true)

Lee Park: I think this smells like kernel fallback jitter + KV-fragmentation. On L4 the optimized attention kernel has a tight sweet spot; pack shapes that flip the kernel decision cause a bunch of micro-restarts.

Ajay Gupta: Reproduced locally on a small harness. When KV cache is cold we see many small batches that force DFS kernel fallback repeatedly. Here's the config snippet I used:

```
max_tokens_per_batch:
  L4: 8192
  A10: 16384
  T4: 4096
  A100: 32768
  H100: 65536
pack_hysteresis_ms: 8
entropy_packing: true
kv_prefetch: false
```

Priya Nair: Two quick ideas: 1) add a small hysteresis window to kernel selection so pack shape oscillation doesn't flip kernels; 2) bump L4 max_tokens to 12k for cold-cache workloads — reduces number of tiny batches. We should run a matrix across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 with kv cold/warm.

Ben Torres: Also check per-core affinity for the L4 driver; we've seen context-switches amplify tail-latency when the driver migrates work. Might be orthogonal but worth validating.

Maria Chen: I'll own the experiment matrix. Plan: run 3x seeds for cold/warm KV, compare (current, hysteresis=8ms, hysteresis=20ms) x (L4 max_tokens 8k/12k/16k). Start with L4 then expand.

Ajay Gupta: Kicking off job group batch-tune/2026-03-18-01. Expect results in ~3h. I'll post thresholds and flamegraphs per GPU family.

perf-bot: Job group scheduled: batch-tune/2026-03-18-01 (targets: L4, A10, T4, A100, H100). Notifications will appear in #eng-runtime when complete.

Maria Chen: If experiments confirm hysteresis fixes p99 without throughput loss we should: 1) add L4 conservative default for cold-cache, 2) add a short note in runtime runbook about pack/kernel oscillation and KV warming.

Ajay Gupta: Agreed. If hysteresis is insufficient we can try dynamic per-model max_tokens derived from observed packing entropy.

Lee Park: One more note — when you run the matrix capture GPU kernel selection traces (kernel_id timeline). It makes the oscillation obvious.

Maria Chen: Great. Thanks all — will post results and flamegraphs in this thread. :thumbsup:
